prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landing-page editorial hero plate. Primary request: top-down still life of overlapping translucent calendar pages recording the same week at different moments, one appointment visibly shifted through the layers, with a small matte-black archival lock and blank index tabs. Scene/backdrop: uncoated warm newsprint desk. Style/medium: refined monochrome cut-paper editorial collage with subtle halftone and photogravure texture. Composition: wide 3:2 frame, subjects concentrated center-right with breathing room, crisp page edges. Lighting: raking window light, quiet archival mood. Palette: bone paper, carbon black, charcoal grey, one restrained oxblood proof mark. Materials: paper fibre, tracing vellum, stamped ink, blackened steel. Constraints: no readable text, no interface screenshot, no people, no logos, no watermark. Avoid: gradients, glossy 3D, blue tech glow, colorful stationery, distorted calendars, brand symbols.
